name: smwmusic-twinkle-star-sprites-neo-geo-love-me-sky-stage
title: Twinkle Star Sprites (Neo Geo) - Love Me (Sky Stage 1)
description:
A happy, cheery song from Twinkle Star Sprites. I've never played this game but I absolutely adore this song. It could best fit energetic levels, probably sky ones as the name implies.

[2022/02/15] Update: Ported the song from scratch for better accuracy and mixing! It's also light-sampled now as a result, with the funniest sample probably being a higher @5 for literally one note that would otherwise overflow.
